modified_caption: The bar chart titled 'Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment' compares the runtime performance of various models on the SEconvo dataset. The horizontal axis categorizes the models, labeled as 'Our Joint Framework,' 'ChatGPT,' 'DeepSeek,' 'LLaMA,' and 'Claude,' ordered from left to right. The vertical axis represents runtime in seconds, featuring a linear scale from 0 to 400, with tick intervals of 50 seconds. The green bar representing 'Our Joint Framework' has a runtime of approximately 77 seconds, while the light blue bars representing the other models have runtimes as follows: 'ChatGPT' at 190 seconds, 'DeepSeek' at 300 seconds, 'LLaMA' at 172 seconds, and 'Claude' at 243 seconds. Notably, 'DeepSeek' demonstrates a runtime reduction compared to 'Claude,' contrary to expectations based on model complexity. Additionally, 'ChatGPT' exhibits a runtime increase of nearly 20% compared to 'LLaMA,' suggesting potential inefficiencies in streaming environments. The numerical labels at the top of each bar provide clarity for runtime values.
